$comment: SYNTHETIC template of the companion manifest of a derived draft (hep-communication, check_adaptation.py). The published-facing prose carries none of these fields; the manifest keeps the claim ids, the omissions and the review. Every value is a placeholder.

brief.audience: public | collaboration | referees | conference | funding panel
brief.record_sha256: <sha256 of the record the draft was written from>

indispensable_limitations.as_written: <the phrase in the draft that states it>

statements.text: <sentence exactly as written in the draft>

omissions.reason: <why that does not change the meaning for this audience>

unresolved_inputs: <missing number or fact and who produces it>
